title: The Fed - Finance and Economics Discussion Series (FEDS) - 2024
summary: This is an index page listing FEDS (Finance and Economics Discussion Series) working papers published in December 2024. It contains abstracts for approximately 11 research papers covering topics including trend-cycle decomposition, Euro Area output gap measurement, hedge fund risk, portfolio choice with heterogeneous beliefs, inflation measurement bias, and monetary policy transmission. This listing page is non-archiveable; individual papers require separate processing.

FEDS 2024-094 studies how household inflation disagreement weakens forward guidance and monetary policy transmission
